name: LeaderLines
description: Represents leader lines on a chart. Leader lines connect data labels to data points.
remarks: This object is not a collection; there is no object that represents a single leader line. This object applies only to pie charts.
example:
With ActiveDocument.InlineShapes(1)

    If .HasChart Then

        With .Chart.SeriesCollection(1)

            .HasDataLabels = True

            .DataLabels.Position = xlLabelPositionBestFit

            .HasLeaderLines = True

            .LeaderLines.Border.ColorIndex = 5

        End With

    End If

End With
